hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */packages/cli/*) cd "${f%%/packages/cli/*}/packages/cli" && cargo fmt && cargo clippy --quiet --all-targets --all-features 2>&1 || true ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.res|*.resi) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { if [ -x packages/envio/node_modules/.bin/rescript ]; then packages/envio/node_modules/.bin/rescript format "$f"; else pnpx "rescript@$(jq -r '.. | .rescript? // empty' packages/envio/package.json | head -1)" format "$f"; fi; } || true ;; esac; }
